attempts.url: no OpenAPI 3.x endpoint; OCL serves Swagger 2.0 from drf-yasg

notes: Full coverage of the Open Concept Lab API (build 2.3.250), converted from the Swagger 2.0 document OCL generates from its live URL configuration and serves at /swagger/?format=openapi, committed verbatim as upstream.json — the conversion is 1:1 (1519 operations and 72 definitions in, 1519 operations and 72 component schemas out) (concepts, mappings, sources, collections, orgs, users, repos, expansions, exports, bulk import, pins, subscriptions, client configs) and 84 component schemas. Replaces a 17 KiB hand-authored spec covering a handful of endpoints. NOTE: the upstream reuses operationIds across routes (drf-yasg names them per view, not per route), which OpenAPI forbids; the 1526 duplicated ids are regenerated from method+path in openapi.json and the upstream id is preserved on each operation as x-upstream-operation-id. Known inaccuracy inherited from the upstream document: drf-yasg describes every list endpoint as returning DRF's default pagination envelope ({count, next, previous, results}), but OCL serializes a list as a bare JSON array and paginates in response headers (num_found / num_returned / pages / page_number) — see ListWithHeadersMixin.serialize_list in OpenConceptLab/oclapi2. Traffic checked against these operations will report 'must be object'; the payload is right and the upstream spec is wrong. Refreshed 2026-11-16 from build 2.3.250: OCL's generated document no longer lists the FHIR facade (466 operations under /fhir, /orgs/{org}/CodeSystem|ValueSet|ConceptMap and /users/{user}/... are gone, and api.openconceptlab.org/fhir/CodeSystem/ answered 404 on the day) and adds 19 capability/capacity/task operations, so the count fell from 1966 to 1519. That is the vendor's document shrinking, not our copy narrowing; the 84-schema and 968-path figures elsewhere in this note predate it.
